description: List expenses accounts (Holded API v2). Cursor-paginated: pass the previous response nextCursor as cursor. Response fields are snake_case; amounts are strings with decimal comma. Each account has `id` (Holded internal id), `name`, and `accountNum` (the PGC account number, e.g. 62900000). NOTE: this endpoint only returns expense/purchase accounts (PGC group 6). Income accounts (group 7, e.g. 700/705/759) are NOT listed here — fetch the full chart via get_chart_of_accounts, or read a known account by id via get_expenses_account.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous response nextCursor

fields.description: Project only these fields per item (e.g. ["id", "name", "accountNum"]). Reduces response size. NOTE: the PGC number field is `accountNum` (not `code`).

limit.description: Max items per page (server-paginated; use limit to control page size)

summary.description: Return only count and pagination metadata without items (default: false)

name: list_expenses_accounts
